newsitem.title: USA: National Computer buys software company.
newsitem.headline: National Computer buys software company.

text.p: National Computer Systems Inc said Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of Macro Educational Systems Inc, which develops administrative software systems for the K-12 education market.

Also, as previously announced, National Computer said it would take one-time charges for the in-process research and development portion of the acquisition price, as well as other acquisition-related costs. The exact amount of these charges is undetermined but should approximate $6 million to $7 million after tax, the company said.

According to terms of the acquisition announced in November, National Computer paid about $7 million in cash at closing and issued $7 million of convertible debentures. Additional payments may be earned based on financial performance.

National Computer chairman and president Russell Gullotti said the acquisition "solidifies our leadership position in the K-12 education software market (and) complements our testing and data collection systems businesses."
